svg.title: The Unified Omnibus — all twenty-two verified results
svg.desc: An animated bus follows twenty-two numbered stops. A passenger and theorem field at every stop represent one field of UnitedTheories.TheoryBundle. Check marks appear as the bus picks up each passenger.
svg.text: One route · 22 theorem stops · every passenger picked up exactly once
Animation restarts after the final pickup · theorem labels and route order are checked against AllTheories.lean
